cc:Work.dc:title: Binary-task quality
cc:Work.dc:description: Observed accuracy across attempted cases. Error bars show nominal Wilson 95% intervals, which do not incorporate passage clustering. Paired cluster contrasts are reported separately. Model quality observations may come from different collection windows.
